name: Total federal expenditure
definition: Grand total of federal expenditure in the Annual Budget Statement's Summary of Expenditure: total current plus total development expenditure (plus any other item the edition prints, such as the estimated operational shortfall in the PSDP).

breaks.note: 18th Amendment and 7th NFC Award: from 2011-12 many health, education and other functions moved largely to the provinces. Federal figures before and after are not comparable.

name: Total current expenditure

name: Current expenditure on revenue account

name: Education (current, revenue account) as a share of total federal expenditure
definition: Federal current expenditure on education (revenue account) as a percentage of total federal expenditure in the same Annual Budget Statement column. Computed by code from two checked values.

breaks.note: 18th Amendment and 7th NFC Award: from 2011-12 many health, education and other functions moved largely to the provinces. Federal figures before and after are not comparable.

derivation.formula: fed.exp.current.function.education_affairs_and_services / fed.exp.total x 100, rounded half-even to 2 decimals; same period and vintage; both inputs must be published
